'''Cabin 524''' was a room in the [[Taupe Corridor]] on the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] ''[[Reasonable Doubt]]''. [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Jai Maruk]] occupied the room along with [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]] [[Whie Malreaux/Legends|Whie Malreaux]] and [[Tallisibeth Enwandung-Esterhazy]] during a mission to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vjun/Legends|Vjun]].<ref name="YDR">''[[Yoda: Dark Rendezvous]]''</ref>
